shortDescription: Validates the status of the replicaset.

options.name: atlas_auth
options.description: Authentication path intended for MongoDB Atlas Instances

options.name: auth_mechanism
options.description: Authentication type.

options.name: connection_options
options.description: Additional connection options. Supply as a list of dicts or strings containing key value pairs seperated with '='.

options.name: interval
options.description: The number of seconds to wait between polling executions.

options.name: login_database
options.description: The database where login credentials are stored.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host running MongoDB instance to login to.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate with. Required when I(login_user) is specified.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The MongoDB server port to login to.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The MongoDB user to login with. Required when I(login_password) is specified.

options.name: poll
options.description: The maximum number of times to query for the replicaset status before the set converges or we fail.

options.name: replica_set
options.description: Replicaset name.

options.name: ssl
options.description: Whether to use an SSL connection when connecting to the database.

options.name: ssl_ca_certs
options.description: The ssl_ca_certs option takes a path to a CA file.

options.name: ssl_cert_reqs
options.description: Specifies whether a certificate is required from the other side of the connection, and whether it will be validated if provided.

options.name: ssl_certfile
options.description: Present a client certificate using the ssl_certfile option.

options.name: ssl_crlfile
options.description: The ssl_crlfile option takes a path to a CRL file.

options.name: ssl_keyfile
options.description: Private key for the client certificate.

options.name: ssl_pem_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase to decrypt encrypted private keys.

options.name: strict_compatibility
options.description: Enforce strict requirements for pymongo and MongoDB software versions

options.name: validate
options.description: The type of validate to perform on the replicaset. default, Suitable for most purposes. Validate that there are an odd number of servers and one is PRIMARY and the remainder are in a SECONDARY or ARBITER state. votes, Check the number of votes is odd and one is a PRIMARY and the remainder are in a SECONDARY or ARBITER state. Authentication is required here to get the replicaset configuration. minimal, Just checks that one server is in a PRIMARY state with the remainder being SECONDARY or ARBITER
